# Study tools, Send to and Anki

## Architecture rules

- **Study tools and Anki** ([details](../../docs/project/tech-stack.md#study-tools-and-anki)): tools only send pause, seek and speed scripts to the one page video. One Send to button (the word card's Anki button, Export's split Send all), never a button per app; AnkiDroid only through its content provider (never its library), AnkiConnect only at `http://127.0.0.1:8765`. Line audio only listens to the page video and never downloads.

## Fork architecture rules

- **Anki**: new cards use the `TripleSub Replay v5` note type (v4 and v3 stay as AnkiConnect fallbacks and are never changed; upstream's "DualSub Replay audio" type is only an AnkiConnect fallback). A changed field list needs a new note type name.

## Full text: docs/project/tech-stack.md, section 'Study tools and Anki'

### Study tools and Anki

- Study tools (owner request 2026-10-20, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-20-study-tools-from-migaku-and-jidoujisho.md)), ideas from Migaku and jidoujisho with no code, assets, data, keys or endpoints of theirs: play modes (pause after each line, read first, listen first, dictation, repeat each line, pause on lines with one new word) and skip silence only send pause, seek and speed scripts to the one page video and need the full transcript.
- Dictation (owner pick 2026-11-09, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-09-dictation-play-mode.md)) pauses like Pause after each line, hides each transcript row until Check or Show reveals it, and types answers in a box under the transcript (`ui/Dictation.kt`, checked by `data/DictationCheck.kt`); answers and reveals live only in memory, and outside the panel (full screen, overlay, TV, live subtitles) it acts like Listen first.
- Known words live in `files/known-words/` (not preferences, so Reset all settings keeps them) and give the subtitle panel's "Known %" score; Known words is off by default (owner decision 2026-10-20), and the word card's "I know this word" (in its More menu) shows only while it is on (owner pick 2026-11-17): with Automatic a word becomes known after it played in 10 lines (5/10/20), each line counted once per video, saved words never, with counts in `files/known-words/<language>.seen` written at most every 30 s and on pause, and "I know this word" marks at once and restarts a count.
- The word card's bar (owner design 2026-11-17, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-17-word-card-action-bar.md), `ui/WordCardActions.kt`) sits under the scrolling part, always in view: a wide Save to Practice, then Ask AI (only while the assistant is on) and Anki (only while Send to shows), and More always at the far right ("I know this word" while Known words is on, and Word card settings, which opens Settings → Word learning); a hidden button leaves its space empty. The deck chip shows only when named decks exist. Settings → Flashcards & Anki holds Video example for saved words (`saved_word_video_example`, on: where the card's own Online example box starts, which still changes the choice for that one word, owner decision 2026-11-18) and Also send saved words (`send_saved_words`, off: Save to Practice sends the card too and the Anki button hides until a send fails). Features that need setup never show on the card before they are set up.
- One Send to button (owner design 2026-10-23, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-23-send-to-button-and-ankiconnect.md)): the word card's Anki button sends to the app picked in Settings (`send_to_app`), and Practice → Export's split Send all button sends to the app last picked on its ▾ list or in Settings: AnkiDroid by default, through its public content provider and runtime permission, never its library (on many phones AnkiDroid answers only while it runs in the background, so a refused card offers Open AnkiDroid), or AnkiConnect at `http://127.0.0.1:8765` only (AnkiConnect Android, Yomitan, asbplayer; `network_security_config.xml` allows cleartext to that address and nothing else; AnkiConnect Android cannot make decks or note types, so cards fall back to Default and Basic there).
- Cards carry sound (owner pick 2026-11-09, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-09-anki-word-and-sentence-audio.md)): Flashcards & Anki has a Front / Back / Off pick each for Word sound, Sentence sound and Picture (owner pick 2026-11-12, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-13-card-sound-places-and-background-loop.md); defaults: word sound where Card front puts it, sentence sound on the back, picture off; the back template starts with `{{FrontSide}}`, so never offer "front and back"): the word in the word card's voice and the line's real sound, which a page script (`ui/LineAudioScripts.kt`) records from the page video's `captureStream()` while it plays (the last 90 s, in memory; it only listens, never downloads, and asks for no permission; a ScriptProcessor with 16384-sample blocks, each timed by the audio clock (samples received against the context's time), because 2048-sample blocks lost sound on a busy phone page and made clips choppy (2026-11-17); AudioWorklet can't be used, YouTube's CSP blocks a blob: worklet module) and only while Send to can be used; clips are `.m4a` in `files/line-audio/` (left out of cloud backups), new cards use the "DualSub Replay audio" note type (AnkiDroid can't add fields to the old one), media reach AnkiDroid through the `${applicationId}.cardaudio` provider (`data/CardMediaProvider.kt`, which reports `.m4a` as `audio/mp4` because AnkiDroid names its copy after the reported type and Android's table says `audio/mpeg`, which made `.mp3`) with a one-copy read grant, a silent clip never goes on a card, and a card sent before its line ended gets its clip once the line has played (`anki_audio_pending`, `ui/LineAudioCapture.kt`).
- Cards also carry a picture and a chosen front (owner pick 2026-11-10, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-10-anki-card-picture-and-front.md)): with Picture on Front or Back a still the page draws from its own video into a canvas while the word's line shows (`webLinePictureScript`, `files/line-pictures/`, left out of cloud backups), else the video's thumbnail from `i.ytimg.com`, in the Source field above the link (no new note type); Card front (Word and sentence by default, Word, Sentence, Listening) is the note type's card template, set again only when the pick changes (`ankidroid_card_front` / `ankiconnect_card_front`), and on AnkiConnect Android's Basic cards it picks the Front and Back fields; never add a separate button per app.
- AnkiDroid deck: the provider's single-note insert ignores a `deckId` and uses the note type's default deck, which drifts (last deck used in AnkiDroid's Add screen, or Default after the deck was deleted), so the fork's `AnkiDroidSender` (`data/AnkiDroidProvisioning.kt`) moves each new card into the `TripleSub Replay` deck through `notes/<id>/cards/0` right after adding it (2026-11-16). The fork keeps its one `TripleSub Replay` deck and does not take upstream's per-language or per-Practice-deck subdecks (owner decision 2026-11-18; a later feature may add them under `TripleSub Replay::<name>`, and `ankiDeckName` is kept only for that); no existing deck is renamed or migrated. AnkiConnect keeps its one chosen deck (the default is the `ANKI_DECK_NAME` technical contract). The line's sound in the Sentence audio field starts with a small "Sentence from the video" label (`labeledSentenceSound`; a card that waits for its clip gets the label with it). The Source link is two links with no text between them (a picture-front template hides only `a` and `br`): "DualSub Replay 1:23", an `intent://www.youtube.com/watch?...#Intent;scheme=https;package=<applicationId>;end` link, because Android hands youtube.com links to the verified YouTube app; then a plain "YouTube" link for desktop Anki. Released AnkiDroid opens intent links freely; its unreleased main branch asks for "allow cards to open other apps" first. Shared and opened links keep their `t=` start (`YouTubeUrlParser.extractStartSeconds`).
- Practice has what a card sent to Anki has (owner request 2026-11-16, `ui/PracticeSounds.kt`): speaker buttons for the word, the line (the kept clip from `LineAudioStore`, else the line read aloud), the meaning and the translation, and the line's picture where Flashcards & Anki → Picture puts it. No setting: buttons play only when tapped.
- Read aloud on the back and Reading (owner pick 2026-11-16, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-16-instant-word-card-read-aloud-ipa-sleep-timer.md)): three chips (Meaning in this sentence, Dictionary meaning, Sentence translation; only the meaning on by default, owner pick after the first preview) record those texts in the meaning's language with the word card's voice (`WordAudioRecorder.recordText`; Google's voice, else the phone's; a part with no voice is left out and never stops a card) and append them to the Meaning and Translation fields, since AnkiDroid can't add fields. Reading (Front / Back / Off, Back by default) moves `{{Reading}}` with its own template-key suffix; on a front without the word it stays on the back. Play first also shows on a Listening front with the word sound on the front (`+wordfirst`; never picked keeps the line first). The word card fetches Google's voice for its line's other words ahead (`WordPronouncer.prepare`), and `PronunciationCache` keeps the last 60 recordings.
- The replay that records a card's sentence sound (a card sent before its line ended) plays muted: `captureStream()` keeps a muted video's sound (emulator check 2026-11-16, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-16-instant-word-card-read-aloud-ipa-sleep-timer.md)). Every way the clip stops gives the video's own mute state back (`window.__dualSubClipUnmute`); the learner's own clip replay keeps its sound.
- Sleep timer (25kiuo, #81, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-16-instant-word-card-read-aloud-ipa-sleep-timer.md)): a row in Settings → Playback (Off, 15, 30, 45, 60 min, End of video) that only sends Pause to the page video through `WebVideoBridge` (`playback/SleepTimer.kt`); End of video also pauses when another video starts. The timer is not saved. The gear popup shows the row too only when Show in quick settings is on (`sleep_timer_in_quick_settings`, off by default).
- The blur box is a page element over the player. Every tool has its own switch: play modes, skip silence and the blur box under Settings → Study tools, Known words and Character details under Word learning, Send to and card audio and pictures under Flashcards & Anki; the assistant can change them (`page_token_captions` waits for a tap).
